product_metadata.title: American Metalcraft SPP326 Ceramic Sugar Packet Holder, 3.5" L x 2.5" W, White
features: Perfect for holding sugar, tea, or sweetener packets
Made of ceramic for classic, professional appearance
Simple, white design works with any table setting
Measures 3.5” L x 2.5” W x 2” H
description: Serve coffee in style with American Metalcraft’s ceramic sugar packet holder. With its simple and timeless look, this holder is perfect for offering sugar, tea, or sweetener packets to the table. The classic, white design makes any table setting look professional and is a must-have for any home or restaurant with lots of coffee drinkers! Each order contains one ceramic sugar packet holder measuring 3.5” L x 2.5” W x 2” H. With 70 years of service, American Metalcraft is a leader in the foodservice industry for trend-focused and unique products.
